# betterado_servicehook_storage_queue_pipelines (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_key` (String, Sensitive) A valid account key from the queue's storage account
- `account_name` (String) The queue's storage account name
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project
- `queue_name` (String) The name of the queue that will store the events

### Optional

- `run_state_changed_event` (Block List, Max: 1) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--run_state_changed_event))
- `stage_state_changed_event` (Block List, Max: 1) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--stage_state_changed_event))
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `ttl` (Number) event time-to-live - the duration a message can remain in the queue before it's automatically removed
- `visi_timeout` (Number) event visibility timout - how long a message is invisible to other consumers after it's been dequeued

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--run_state_changed_event"></a>
### Nested Schema for `run_state_changed_event`

Optional:

- `pipeline_id` (String) The pipeline ID to be monitored. If not specified, all pipelines in the project will trigger the event
- `run_result_filter` (String) Which run result should generate an event. Only valid if published_event is `RunStateChanged`. If not specified, all results will trigger the event
- `run_state_filter` (String) Which run state should generate an event. Only valid if published_event is `RunStateChanged`. If not specified, all states will trigger the event


<a id="nestedblock--stage_state_changed_event"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stage_state_changed_event`

Optional:

- `pipeline_id` (String) The pipeline ID to be monitored. If not specified, all pipelines in the project will trigger the event
- `stage_name` (String) Which stage should generate an event. Only valid if published_event is `StageStateChanged`. If not specified, all stages will trigger the event
- `stage_result_filter` (String) Which stage result should generate an event. Only valid if published_event is `StageStateChanged`. If not specified, all results will trigger the event
- `stage_state_filter` (String) Which stage state should generate an event. Only valid if published_event is `StageStateChanged`. If not specified, all states will trigger the event
